SPSS-Style One-Way ANOVA Table (HTML)

spss_anova_html.Rd

Creates an HTML ANOVA table from bg_anova_answers() output or raw data.

Usage

spss_anova_html(data, dv = NULL, iv = NULL, digits = 3)

Arguments

data

A data frame, OR output from bg_anova_answers().

dv

Character. DV name (ignored if data is anova results).

iv

Character. IV name (ignored if data is anova results).

digits

Integer. Decimal places. Default 3.

Value

HTML string (invisibly).

Examples

data(superman)
spss_anova_html(superman, "rt_critics_score", "clark_grp")
